audit_name: Phase 6D Research-Grade Verification & Evaluation Integrity Audit

discrepancy_resolution.explanation: The previous narrative summary misreported the 4 failures as (1 Chillies, 3 Maize) and misidentified farm IDs. The physical features CSV on disk, the manifest, and the training pipeline were completely aligned and correct: Manifest had 51 Chillies (2 failed -> 49 valid), 51 Maize (1 failed -> 50 valid), 50 Paddy (1 failed -> 49 valid), and 50 each for Bengal Gram, Cotton, Groundnut, Red Gram (0 failed). Total evaluated rows = 348.

mgrs_mosaicking_audit.finding: For moderate 2-tile overlaps, delta NDVI < 0.009. For heavy 3-4 tile overlaps (29.3% of all farms), daily tile duplication overweights individual dates in the raw median by 8-10% band reflectance, producing up to +0.028 delta in NDVI and +0.035 in NDMI.

spatial_validation_audit.crs: EPSG:32644 (UTM Zone 44N, Telangana - Conformal metric projection)
spatial_validation_audit.buffer_exclusion_risk: Enforcing a 15 km spatial buffer between training and test sets would eliminate 89.7% of all labeled farms, causing severe data starvation and leaving only 36 farms.
spatial_validation_audit.spatial_blocks_risk: 50 km projected spatial blocks cause severe class dropout (only 1 out of 24 blocks contains all 7 crops), doubling cross-validation variance (std from 0.057 to 0.109).
spatial_validation_audit.recommendation: Maintain Sub-District StratifiedGroupKFold as primary benchmark (guarantees 0 administrative group leakage, 7-class representation in every fold, and balanced fold sizes). Disclose inter-mandal boundary proximity transparently in research limitations.
